post.title: Your safe deposit box isn't FDIC insured. Here's what is
post.ig:
The cash in your safe deposit box? Not FDIC insured.

FDIC covers deposits up to $250,000 per depositor, per bank, per ownership category.
Not covered: stocks, bonds, mutual funds, crypto, annuities, safe deposit box contents.
Example: $300,000 in one name at one bank leaves $50,000 uninsured. A 2-owner joint account: up to $500,000.
Many apps aren't banks: when Synapse collapsed in 2024, FDIC insurance didn't apply.

Sources: FDIC.gov, CNBC (2024).
News and education, not financial advice.
